```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-decl "<!ENTITY internal 'Resolved Internal Entity'>">
  %ent-decl;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "ext.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/ns/catalog" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment: Testing complex entity expansion and CDATA sections -->
  <item id="1">
    <?item-processing-instruction mode="verbose"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like strings: <item>&internal;</item>
    ]]>
    &ext;
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST record code ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY e1 "First Level">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Second Level">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT nested (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/ns/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Parent comment block with multiple nested entity references -->
  <record code="rec1" xlink:type="simple">
    <?archive-pi target="validate" data="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Data payload with CDATA: <nested>&e2;</nested>
    ]]>
  </record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity Text">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; with extra suffix">
  <!NOTATION text-format SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY note SYSTEM "notes.txt" NDATA text-format>
  <!ENTITY % p-ent "<!ENTITY param-ent 'Parameter Entity Value'>">
  %p-ent;
]>
<?xml-target param="value"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/root" xmlns:custom="http://example.org/ns/custom">
  <!-- Comment before custom namespace elements and CDATA -->
  <custom:section id="sec-01">
    <?custom-pi action="execute"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw CDATA segment: &derived; &param-ent;
    ]]>
  </custom:section>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Entity">
  <!ENTITY beta "α -> Beta Entity">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ENTITY macro-res 'Macro Expanded'>">
  %dtd-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" type="text/css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/ns/inventory" xmlns:store="http://example.org/ns/store">
  <!-- Top comment detailing inventory state -->
  <store:product code="P100">
    <?store-pi command="audit"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Content inside CDATA: <store:item>β &macro-res;</store:item>
    ]]>
  </store:product>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "Value A">
  <!ENTITY entB "Value B: &entA;">
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ELEMENT node-ext (#PCDATA)>">
  %ext-macro;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual "user_manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-hiphop version="1.0"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.org/ns/doc" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment encompassing multiple directives -->
  <node id="n1" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <?svg-pi action="render"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block embedding entities: &entB;
    ]]>
  </node>
</document>
```
